protocol.current_policy: First4 actual H2 action RHS, reuse actual z0/q from first correction, normalize score by||t||². Rebuild original C once, continue H1 with no reset or RHS replacement.
protocol.stopping: Recursive residual<=.5e-8||b|| then literal original residual<=1e-8. Failure is retained, with no hidden repair.
protocol.static_FIRST8: Direct single mixed build, no preliminary all32 factor or mask selection.
protocol.FPS: Existing SharedKernel.farthest evaluates distance and Gaussian exp; per-solver hypothetical counts charged separately from shared offline setup.
protocol.accounting: All analytical solver Gaussian entries include FPS, streamed factor/rebuild, score core products, actions, boundary4 products, reconstruction and original verification. Extra gap/reference diagnostics are separately disclosed.
protocol.scope: Dense actual inexact trajectories; no native runtime or full-memory claim.
